data.title: Exchange semester admission, Fall 2025
data.summary: Example Liberal Arts College (Office of Global Education) has admitted Aisha Okafor to its Fall 2025 exchange semester. The signed enrollment confirmation must reach the college by 29 April 2025.
data.explanation: You have been admitted to the exchange semester in Fall 2025 at Example Liberal Arts College in the USA. To keep your place, you must return the signed enrollment confirmation so that it reaches the college's office by 29 April 2025. Unconfirmed places are offered to students on the waitlist. Send it in good time, because it must arrive by that date, not just be posted. Keep a copy or proof of sending.
